correctness.rationale: Horn closure monotonicity makes every explanation family order-convex in Boolean inclusion order. One omission witness per context in a minimal obstruction is distinct; any strict three-chain would violate the middle family order-convexity. A random maximal Boolean chain meets witnesses at most twice, and the 2-LYM/Sperner inequality bounds their cardinality by the two largest levels. For sharpness use all k and k+1 subsets, remove one per context, realize each order-convex family as upward closure intersection downward closure through finite exact context guards, g and integrity heads; the rules are acyclic. h=0 singleton and h=1 nonempty-family boundaries are handled, with first values 1,2,3,6,10,20,35.
